title: plagiobothrys kingii var. harknessii
intro: Plagiobothrys kingii var. harknessii, commonly known as Harkness's popcorn flower or popcorn flower, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Plagiobothrys kingii var. harknessii include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in relieving respiratory problems and alleviating symptoms of bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
